title: TD Asset Management Inc. expands investment lineup with launch of TD Canadian Corporate Bond Index ETF (Ticker: TCB) and TD Canadian Government Bond Index ETF (Ticker: TGB)
body_markdown:
# **TD Asset Management Inc. expands investment lineup with launch of TD Canadian Corporate Bond Index ETF (Ticker: TCB) and TD Canadian Government Bond Index ETF (Ticker: TGB)**


Published: November 24, 2026


TORONTO, Nov. 24, 2026 /CNW/ -- TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), the manager of TD Exchange-Traded Funds (TD ETFs), today announced the launch of two new investment solutions: TD Canadian Corporate Bond Index ETF and TD Canadian Government Bond Index ETF.


Providing investors with broad Canadian corporate and government bond exposure at a lower cost, the new TD ETFs seek to generate income and can contribute to the fixed income component of a diversified portfolio. The new TD ETFs also complement each other, giving investors the flexibility to fine-tune the amount of government versus corporate bond exposure desired in their portfolio.


**TD Canadian Corporate Bond Index ETF ("TCB")**


TCB seeks to track the performance of the Solactive Broad Canadian Corporate Bond TR Index1 (the "Benchmark") by investing primarily in Canadian-issued corporate bonds and debentures that are selected and weighted mathematically to approximate the overall risk and return characteristics of the Benchmark. Key features include:


- *Investment-grade corporate bond exposure:* A diversified portfolio of investment-grade Canadian corporate bonds
- *Enhanced income potential:* Corporate bonds offer the opportunity for higher yields compared with government bonds, helping to support portfolio income
- *Index management expertise:* TDAM has over 25 years of managing passive index bond mandates


**TD Canadian Government Bond Index ETF ("TGB")**


TGB seeks to track the performance of the Solactive Broad Canadian Government Bond TR Index1 (the "Benchmark") by investing primarily in Canadian- issued bonds and debentures that are selected and weighted mathematically to approximate the overall risk and return characteristics of the Benchmark. Key features include:


- *Investment-grade government bond exposure:* A diversified portfolio of investment-grade government bonds issued or backed by Canadian federal, provincial or municipal governments
- *Designed to reduce risk:* Government bonds are known for safety and stability when compared to corporate bonds, helping to support portfolios in times of heightened volatility


"TCB and TGB are convenient ways for investors to access broad Canadian corporate and government bond exposure at a lower cost," said Jennifer Hartviksen, CFA, Managing Director, Head of Global Fixed Income. "Designed for medium to long-term investors, the new TD ETFs are complementary and can be used as building blocks to customize the amount of government versus corporate bond exposure desired in portfolios. Investors also benefit from the strength of our experienced fixed income investments team, which leverages proprietary tools to help select bonds that closely match the risk and return characteristics of their respective benchmarks."


For more information about our complete suite of TD ETFs, including the prospectus or ETF Facts, visit td.com/etfs.
